Tombone: Legend of the Cave Babes

name: Tombone: Legend of the Cave Babes
storyline: Chaos comes to Wild Island in the form of the dinosaur Princess Dyna, who with her Reptite army begin to take over the island, kidnapping the cave babes from all across the region and setting her grunts loose to pillage the island. Tombone and his best friend Tinka team up with other a cast of characters to put a stop to Dyna and the Reptites rampage.
summary: Tombone is a fast paced action-adventure game set in a fantastic prehistoric world. Jump, climb, and slide through vast levels full of collectibles, bash loads of enemies, and go toe to toe in huge boss fights as you save the world and the cave babes.
